description.value: Polish Bistro is a Polish cuisine restaurant in Penticton, British Columbia, operating from a compact single-storey retail building. Penticton is a hub on the Okanagan cycling circuit and near the Kettle Valley Rail Trail, making it a natural resupply point for touring riders. A Polish menu typically offers hearty, filling dishes — a welcome prospect after a long day in the saddle.
